daily_counts.purpose: How many times each link was followed on each UTC day. This table is the only place the service records anything about a click.

link_id.purpose: Which link the count belongs to.
link_id.retention: Kept while the link exists, including after it expires. Removed with the rest of the row when the link is deleted.

day.purpose: The UTC calendar date the follows happened on, as YYYY-MM-DD.
day.retention: Kept while the link exists, including after it expires. Removed with the rest of the row when the link is deleted.

count.purpose: How many times the link was followed that day. A row exists only for a day on which it was followed at least once.
count.retention: Kept while the link exists, including after it expires. Removed with the rest of the row when the link is deleted.

links.purpose: Every short link a team member has made, including deleted ones, whose names stay reserved.

id.purpose: An internal number that ties a link to its daily counts.
id.retention: Kept for as long as the database exists, including after the link expires or is deleted.

name.purpose: The short name the link is followed by.
name.retention: Kept for as long as the database exists, including after the link expires or is deleted, so the name is never reused.

target.purpose: The long URL the short link redirects to.
target.retention: Kept while the link exists, including after it expires. Replaced with an empty string when the link is deleted.

created_at.purpose: When the link was made, in UTC, to the second.
created_at.retention: Kept for as long as the database exists, including after the link expires or is deleted.

expires_at.purpose: When the link stops redirecting, in UTC, if whoever made it set an expiry. No value is stored for a link that never expires.
expires_at.retention: Kept for as long as the database exists, including after the link expires or is deleted.

deleted_at.purpose: When the link was deleted, in UTC, to the second. No value is stored for a link that has not been deleted.
deleted_at.retention: Written when the link is deleted, and kept from then on for as long as the database exists.

created_by.purpose: An optional free-text label sent by whoever made the link, such as their name. The service does not check that it is true.
created_by.retention: Kept while the link exists, including after it expires. Erased when the link is deleted.

schema_version.purpose: Which database migrations have been applied. It holds nothing about links or about the people who follow them.

version.purpose: The number of one applied migration.
version.retention: Kept for as long as the database exists. Deleting or expiring a link does not touch it.
